description:
## 1.36.0-dev.103 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: close P preview from the top-level key release path so it cannot stay stuck open.
- Reddit: remove the O-key center fallback that disturbed focus when comment collapse was unavailable.
- Reddit: detect post detail from focused comment semantics when the next-comment button is missing.
- Reddit: disable default focus highlight on preview overlays.
